sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा तु राजानम् मातरम् च सुमन्त्र मे ।अन्याः च देवीः सहिताः कैकेयीम् च पुनः पुनः ॥२-५२-३०॥
transliteration: evam uktvā tu rājānam mātaram ca sumantra me ।anyāḥ ca devīḥ sahitāḥ kaikeyīm ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥2-52-30॥

translations.english: Having said this to the king, O Sumantra tell my mother, the other queens including Kaikeyi again and again about my wellbeing and the wellbeing of Lakshmana and Sita. Convey our respectful salutations at the feet of mother Kausalya.
